feedback.partial_rollout: Admission and Composition feedback hashes must agree. Transport is unchanged and consumes their reviewed request/admission bindings.

bg1: Explicit non-POSIX test branch; no skips or allowlist edits.
bg2: Real ubuntu-24.04-arm job invokes identical parent/exec workers, boundary inspection, exact private ten-verdict assertion, registry readback and daemon absence; additionally exercises javac failure.
verifier_setup: Same pinned C1 fetch inside qualification job RUNNER_TEMP; no setup job; no agent fetch/read.
public_ci_evidence: Only verdict counts, hashes and cleanup records; no bundle, frozen cases, per-case output, compile stderr or private directory upload.
network: Asset fetch and two digest-pinned image pulls only for qualification work; normal GitHub checkout/setup/upload transport. Every candidate/build/collector container has --network=none; --pull=never.

bg3.partition: 18 seconds worker daemon cleanup; 2 seconds worker-group reap; 10 seconds parent fallback removal/inspect. All bounded by incoming original deadline.
bg3.timing_claim: No Docker Desktop timing claim. Proposed C2-only reserve must pass CI and attended rehearsal; a late/uncertain cleanup is terminal.

bg4: Only successful Docker exec plus matching private javac-exit readback establishes a completed compiler exit. Only javac exit 1 permits compile feedback. Exit 0 is successful compilation; every other value, including 2/3/4 and signal/launch statuses, is terminal with no feedback. First compile failure repairs once; repair compile failure CANDIDATE_FAIL.
composition: Feedback tagged union; fixed signal plus first 4096 UTF-8 bytes of this stderr, C0 normalized then checked, no generic slash filter; only host file mounted is /source/Main.java; no stdout. Frozen feedback reused for analysis and repair. Existing verifier counts unchanged.
coordinated_binding: Admission and Composition feedback hash constants updated together. Transport is unchanged and consumes their reviewed request/admission bindings. E2 role caps/holds and budget hash unchanged. Updated analysis/repair instruction hash included.
push_authority: Requires Claude review and Howard exact approval: existing gate and merged sources change.
bg5: Redactor and validator share the same byte/C0 rules. Java slash literals, comments and markup remain intact. Forbidden C0 is printable escaped text, then the 4096-byte projection cap is enforced.
bg6_source_basis: OpenJDK jdk-21.0.9+10 Main.Result: OK=0; ERROR=1; CMDERR=2; SYSERR=3; ABNORMAL=4. Exact tagged source read; this is a pinned implementation convention, not a stable public API guarantee.
